title: Identification of sepsis pyroptosis-related genes based on single-cell sequencing technology and experimental verification.
authors: Leng, Linghan; Wang, Hao; Hu, Yingchun; Yang, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞测序和机器学习筛选脓毒症焦亡相关生物标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to screen for new biomarkers for sepsis. Firstly, peripheral blood samples from 23 sepsis patients and 10 healthy volunteers were collected according to the sepsis 3.0 criteria and analyzed by RNA-seq. A total of 876 pyroptosis-related genes were sourced from the Genecards database. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was then employed to pinpoint genes linked to sepsis clinical modules significantly associated with the phenotype. An intersection analysis with pyroptosis-related genes was conducted, resulting in the identification of 60 common genes. Then, two core genes (BCL6 and JAK2) were jointly identified using three types of machine learning: random forest, SVM, and Lasso regression. Expression analysis showed that both were significantly highly expressed in the sepsis group, and the subject work characteristic curve (ROC) analysis demonstrated that their diagnostic efficacies were high in both of them in the multiple datasets (AUC value > 0.88), and meta-analysis revealed their correlation with the prognostic status of sepsis patients, and GSEA analysis showed that BCL6 was mainly enriched in metabolism-related pathways, while JAK2 was significantly involved in inflammatory signaling pathways. In addition, immune infiltration analysis showed that BCL6 and JAK2 were closely associated with the infiltration of a variety of immune cells, suggesting their potential functions in regulating the immune microenvironment. Finally, single-cell sequencing localization showed that BCL6 and JAK2 were mainly distributed in macrophages and B cells. Mendelian Randomization Analysis Suggests BCL6, JAK2 Expression Levels May Influence the Risk of Sepsis. The experimental results verified the expression status of key genes. Clinical trial number for this study: ChiCTR1900021261 Registration date: February 4, 2019.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在筛选脓毒症的新型生物标志物。首先，根据脓毒症3.0标准，收集了23名脓毒症患者和10名健康志愿者的外周血样本，并通过RNA-seq进行分析。从Genecards数据库中共获取了876个与焦亡相关的基因。随后，采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）来识别与脓毒症临床模块显著相关且与表型相关的基因。与焦亡相关基因进行交集分析，共鉴定出60个共同基因。然后，通过三种机器学习方法——随机森林、支持向量机和Lasso回归——联合识别出两个核心基因（BCL6和JAK2）。表达分析显示，这两个基因在脓毒症组中均显著高表达，受试者工作特征曲线（ROC）分析表明，它们在多个数据集中的诊断效能均较高（AUC值>0.88），荟萃分析揭示了它们与脓毒症患者预后状态的相关性，GSEA分析显示BCL6主要富集于代谢相关通路，而JAK2显著参与炎症信号通路。此外，免疫浸润分析显示，BCL6和JAK2与多种免疫细胞的浸润密切相关，提示它们在调节免疫微环境中的潜在功能。最后，单细胞测序定位显示，BCL6和JAK2主要分布在巨噬细胞和B细胞中。孟德尔随机化分析提示，BCL6和JAK2的表达水平可能影响脓毒症的风险。实验结果验证了关键基因的表达状态。本研究的临床试验编号：ChiCTR1900021261；注册日期：2019年2月4日。
